refnamediv.refpurpose: Check if a stream is a TTY

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &true; if stream is connected to a terminal, &false; otherwise. &false; is also returned for streams that have no file descriptor (such as php://memory, php://temp and php://output, or directory handles), and for a terminal stream that has a stream filter attached.
